quotes.quote: 교과목의 영역 인정 여부는 학생의 입학년도 공통교육과정 이수규정을 기준으로 판단함

steps.text: The area a general-education (교양) course counts toward depends on the rules for your admission year. A new course whose area did not exist in your entry year counts only as general credit. Check this before you rely on a course for graduation.
steps.title: Check how general-education courses count for your entry year

quotes.quote: 2016학년도 이후 모든 공과대학 학부 및 대학원 신(편)입생
수강기간 내 미이수 시 예외적인 추가 수강 불가

steps.text: Engineering entrants since 2016 must complete the 생명존중 (suicide prevention) course on eTL. Watch at least 80% of the video, then take the quiz. If you miss the course period, no extra session is offered.
steps.title: Complete the suicide-prevention course on eTL

quotes.quote: 면담 후 면담 확인서에 교수님 도장(싸인)받아 원본 제출
앞의 1,2,3 절차를 하지 않고 수강신청만 한 학생은 모두 'F' 처리됨

steps.text: Choose a 졸업프로젝트 (graduation project) topic on the department intranet. Meet the professor and submit the signed 면담확인서 (interview form). Then register for the course. If you only register for the course and skip these steps, you receive an F.
steps.title: Choose a graduation project topic and register

quotes.quote: 학생은 2회 불참(또는 지각)이면 F가 부여되오니 반드시 출석을 해주세요.
중간발표 외 최종발표는 1회라도 미출석시 'F'가 부여될 수 있음

steps.text: Attendance is checked at the start of each session, and arriving late counts the same as missing it. One absence lowers your grade by one step. Two absences mean an F. Missing the final presentation can also mean an F.
steps.title: Attend every graduation project session on time

quotes.quote: PDF 파일만 업로드 가능 / 사이즈는 A1 / 세로방향
지도교수님께 논문 초안 및 포스터 초안을 검토받으셔야 합니다.

steps.text: Upload your final poster as a PDF in A1 portrait format. Your advisor must review your thesis draft and poster draft before the final poster presentation. Stay at your poster during the whole judging time.
steps.title: Submit your poster and get your drafts reviewed

quotes.quote: 논문 작성과 인준지 서명은 전부 졸업프로젝트 학기에 해야 합니다.
졸업을 하지 않으면서 졸업논문만 제출할 수 없음

steps.text: Write the graduation thesis and get your advisor's signature on the 인준지 (approval page) in your project semester. Submit it in your graduating semester. If you are not graduating yet, keep the signed copy. You cannot submit a thesis without graduating.
steps.title: Write your thesis and get the advisor's signature

quotes.quote: 모든 동영상 100% 수강 및 학습자료(PDF) 다운로드·열람 시 이수 인정되며
중 한 과목 반드시 이수해야함(2022년 1학기 입학생부터 적용)

steps.text: New graduate students take the online research ethics course on eTL. All videos and the PDF must be completed for it to count. Students admitted from 2022 on must also pass one research ethics course (교과목) before graduating.
steps.title: Complete research ethics training

quotes.quote: 미제출 시 성적은 U로 부여됩니다

steps.text: In every semester you register for 논문연구 (Thesis Research), fill in the Google Form. Then submit the confirmation form, signed by your professor, to Room 319. If you do not submit it, your grade is U.
steps.title: Submit the Thesis Research form every semester

quotes.quote: 등록 2학기 째가 되는 분
전기정보공학부 대학원 교과목 중 6학점 이상 이수한 자
석사: 100점 만점에 60점 이상 합격

steps.text: Take the 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam) in your second registered semester. To be eligible you need: six ECE graduate credits, a pass in English, and new lab safety, suicide-prevention and human-rights training. You pass with an average of 60 or more.
steps.title: Pass the thesis qualifying exam in your second semester

quotes.quote: 석사·박사 4학기 이상 등록하고 수료에 필요한 학점을 취득한 경우
전 교과목 및 전공교과목의 성적 평점평균이 각각 3.0 이상(4.3. 만점 기준)
첨부파일 신청서 작성(지도교수 날인 포함)하여 319호 담당자 앞 제출

steps.text: For 수료 (coursework completion) you need at least four registered semesters, 24 credits including nine ECE graduate credits, and a GPA of 3.0 or higher. To count courses from other departments, submit the approval form with your advisor's stamp.
steps.title: Meet the coursework completion requirements

quotes.quote: 논문지 투고를 증명하는 서류는 제출하여도 인정 불가 (종전 인정 지침 폐지)
본인의 이름이 첫 번째로 되어 있어도 공동1저자라면 인정 불가

steps.text: You need one conference or journal paper that is published or accepted. You must be the first author after your advisor, and your advisor must be a co-author. Proof of submission alone does not count. Co-first authorship does not count.
steps.title: Publish one first-author paper with your advisor

quotes.quote: 학부행정실 서류제출까지 마치셔야 최종완료됩니다.
논문심사위원 선정시 반드시 본교 전기·정보공학부 교원을 포함하여야 한다.
미제출 시 학위를 받을 수 없음

steps.text: Register online for thesis review and hand in the documents to the office. Your committee must include an ECE faculty member. Pay the review fee and submit the result documents. If you submit no final thesis, you get no degree.
steps.title: Apply for thesis review and submit final thesis

quotes.quote: 모든 동영상 100% 수강 및 학습자료(PDF) 다운로드·열람 시 이수 인정되며
중 한 과목 반드시 이수해야함(2022년 1학기 입학생부터 적용)

steps.text: New graduate students take the online research ethics course on eTL. All videos and the PDF must be completed for it to count. Students admitted from 2022 on must also pass one research ethics course (교과목) before graduating.
steps.title: Complete research ethics training

quotes.quote: 등록 2학기 째가 되는 분
박사&석박통합: 100점 만점에 70점 이상 합격

steps.text: Take the 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam) in your second registered semester. To be eligible you need: six ECE graduate credits, a pass in English, and new lab safety, suicide-prevention and human-rights training. You pass with an average of 70 or more.
steps.title: Pass the thesis qualifying exam in your second semester

quotes.quote: 박사 예비심사는 초심/ 종심 이전 학기까지 완료해야 함
예심에서의 위원장은 지도교수입니다.

steps.text: After passing the 논자시, complete the 예비심사 (preliminary review) by the semester before your thesis defense. Your advisor chairs this committee. Submit the committee report first. Then submit the guidance report and the journal confirmation form.
steps.title: Finish the preliminary review one semester before defense

quotes.quote: 석사·박사 4학기 이상 등록하고 수료에 필요한 학점을 취득한 경우
전 교과목 및 전공교과목의 성적 평점평균이 각각 3.0 이상(4.3. 만점 기준)
첨부파일 신청서 작성(지도교수 날인 포함)하여 319호 담당자 앞 제출

steps.text: For 수료 (coursework completion) you need at least four registered semesters, 36 credits including 12 ECE graduate credits, and a GPA of 3.0 or higher. To count courses from other departments, submit the approval form with your advisor's stamp.
steps.title: Meet the coursework completion requirements

quotes.quote: (1항) 국제적으로 인정되는 논문지(SCI(E)급)에 1편 이상의 논문을 게재 또는 게재확정
지도교수를 제외한 모든 공동1저자의 인원수에 따라 1/N로 나누어 성과를 인정합니다.

steps.text: You need one SCI(E) journal paper, plus one international conference paper, domestic journal paper or registered international patent. Each must be published or accepted, with your advisor as co-author. A co-first-author paper counts as 1/N.
steps.title: Publish the required papers with your advisor

quotes.quote: 박사 논문심사(초심, 종심) 신청 대상: 지난 학기에 예비심사를 합격한 자
심사위원은 5명이고 지도교수가 부위원장이 됩니다.
미제출 시 학위를 받을 수 없음

steps.text: After passing the preliminary review, register online for the thesis review. It has a 초심 (first review) and a 종심 (final review). The committee has five members, and your advisor is vice-chair. Present publicly and submit the final thesis to receive the degree.
steps.title: Apply for thesis review and defend your thesis

quotes.quote: 모든 동영상 100% 수강 및 학습자료(PDF) 다운로드·열람 시 이수 인정되며
중 한 과목 반드시 이수해야함(2022년 1학기 입학생부터 적용)

steps.text: New graduate students take the online research ethics course on eTL. All videos and the PDF must be completed for it to count. Students admitted from 2022 on must also pass one research ethics course (교과목) before graduating.
steps.title: Complete research ethics training

quotes.quote: 2학기 째에 반드시 포기원/지속원을 제출해야 합니다.
추후 석박통합과정으로의 변경은 불가!!

steps.text: In your second semester, submit a 지속원 (continuation form) or a 포기원 (give-up form, master's degree only), signed by your advisor. Once you submit a 포기원, you cannot return to the integrated program.
steps.title: Submit the continuation or give-up form

quotes.quote: 입학 후 셋째 학기 초에 박사과정 논문제출자격시험에 응시하여 합격하여야 한다.
최대 2회의 다음 학기 재응시가 가능하나
박사&석박통합: 100점 만점에 70점 이상 합격

steps.text: Early in your third semester, take and pass the PhD 논자시 (thesis qualifying exam). You need an average of 70 or more. If you fail, you can retake it up to twice, but only if the committee approves your advisor's petition.
steps.title: Pass the PhD qualifying exam in your third semester

quotes.quote: 박사 예비심사는 초심/ 종심 이전 학기까지 완료해야 함
예심에서의 위원장은 지도교수입니다.

steps.text: After passing the 논자시, complete the 예비심사 (preliminary review) by the semester before your thesis defense. Your advisor chairs this committee. Submit the committee report first. Then submit the guidance report and the journal confirmation form.
steps.title: Finish the preliminary review one semester before defense

quotes.quote: 석박사통합과정 6학기 이상 등록하고 수료에 필요한 학점을 취득한 경우
전 교과목 및 전공교과목의 성적 평점평균이 각각 3.0 이상(4.3. 만점 기준)
첨부파일 신청서 작성(지도교수 날인 포함)하여 319호 담당자 앞 제출

steps.text: For 수료 (coursework completion) you need at least six registered semesters, 60 credits including 21 ECE graduate credits, and a GPA of 3.0 or higher. To count courses from other departments, submit the approval form with your advisor's stamp.
steps.title: Meet the coursework completion requirements

quotes.quote: (1항) 국제적으로 인정되는 논문지(SCI(E)급)에 1편 이상의 논문을 게재 또는 게재확정
심사위원은 5명이고 지도교수가 부위원장이 됩니다.
미제출 시 학위를 받을 수 없음

steps.text: You need one SCI(E) journal paper plus one conference paper, domestic journal paper or patent, all published or accepted with your advisor as co-author. Then register for the 초심/종심 (first/final review) with a five-member committee and submit the final thesis.
steps.title: Publish required papers, then defend your thesis
